items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1989-08-13
items.q: I'm talking about the John Tobins and the Mickey Mouse bands at the, at the Grunewald

ctx.x: And, uh, of course it was in a period when the big bands were popular here. I don't mean the swing bands, I'm talking about the John Tobins and the Mickey Mouse bands at the, at the Grunewald and all that. Uh huh. And, uh, so they weren't, uh, you didn't hear any jazz. I mean you had to go out of your way to find any jazz. Uh huh. And even the little joints that later would become jazz joints weren't playing jazz.
